# Version 11 export fixture

`session-export-v11.json` was written by the 0.0.3 release's export writer from a
synthesized offline session: neutral history covering compaction, text and
image input, commentary, visible reasoning, a code-mode call with a nested
local call and both results, a citation and a refusal, plus a held follow-up,
prompt history and a transcript row. The workspace root is a placeholder.
Version 12 imports it onto the local runner under the home default profile and
re-exports the identical canonical history.
